settings.deleteAccountConfirmMessage:
Withdrawal ends your MachineFit access.

• Immediate: anonymize email/name, delete region/home-gym/body/birth fields, unlink live social logins, clear session tokens. We attempt to cancel paid subscriptions.
• About 30 days later: workouts, favorites, friends, posts, photos, trades, online PT, tickets, templates, achievements, feature-usage counters, ops activity/access logs linked to you, gym member lists you own, uploads.
• Kept longer (no auto-expiry job; deleted when purpose ends / law allows): payment/subscription evidence, consent records, trial-abuse identity keys, social-provider identifier archive (rejoin/audit/dispute).
• Rejoining does not restore the old account.

terms.s1Body: MachineFit provides machine-setting suggestions, workout logging, and community features for reference. It is not medical advice.
terms.s2Body: You must provide accurate information and keep your account secure. Platform accounts require age 14+. At signup we compute full years from your date of birth in Korea time on the server.
terms.s3Body: You are responsible for photos, posts, and listings you upload. Unlawful content may be reported and removed.
terms.s4Body: Recommendations and AI insights are estimates. Liability is limited to the extent permitted by law.
terms.s5Body: For terms or service questions, contact the operator through in-app channels.
terms.s6Body: Paid memberships, free trials, renewals, and cancellations follow the e-commerce & refund policy and checkout notices. A free trial may start automatically for new accounts.
terms.s7Body: On withdrawal you cannot sign in, identifiers are anonymized, and live social links are removed. About 30 days later workouts, posts, usage data, and uploads are deleted. Payment/consent evidence, trial-abuse keys, and social-provider identifier archives may be kept longer for law, disputes, and rejoin controls. Rejoining creates a new account.
terms.s8Body: Account theft, unauthorized scraping, disruption, unlawful or infringing content, and payment circumvention are forbidden. We may restrict access and cooperate with authorities.
terms.s9Body: UI, recommendation logic, and catalog structure belong to the operator. Brand and machine photos belong to their rights holders and are removed on a valid complaint.
terms.s10Body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea. Business registration details will appear in the footer after registration is complete. Contact: machinefit.official@gmail.com

legal.cookieNotice: We do not use advertising/marketing tracking cookies or ad SDKs. Sign-in uses sessionStorage and an HttpOnly cookie (when allowed). UI prefs, recent searches, notice dismissals, and PWA flags may use device localStorage. Operational usage stats for reliability are collected via app→server API (see Privacy Policy), not ad cookies.
legal.privacyLead: How we collect and use personal data.

privacy.s1Body: We may process: social login provider id and email/avatar URL (when provided); display name; date of birth required at signup (age 14+ check; no resident registration number); gender/height/weight/age/birth time (when entered, e.g. fortune); workout goals/experience/units; home gym; optional administrative region (city/district only — we do not collect, store, or send member GPS/current-location coordinates); workout logs, plan cards, templates, achievements, and derived growth/DNA insights; friends, notifications, photos, trades, online PT, support tickets, reports; payment/subscription metadata (e.g. Polar customer/subscription ids; card numbers stay with the PSP); per-feature usage counters (daily/monthly); operational telemetry (page path, dwell time, session id, device/OS/browser class, IP, User-Agent, per-user activity day — for reliability/security/quality); consent and login logs (IP/UA); banner impression/click events (session id only; no member user id); refresh tokens (sessionStorage + HttpOnly cookie); and device-local localStorage for UI prefs/search/dismissals. Gym-owner facility member lists (name/email/birth date) are for facility management and may include under-14 members (not MachineFit accounts).
privacy.s2Body: Used for authentication and age-14 checks, machine recommendations, workout logging/growth analysis/achievements/fortune, community/friends, support, free/paid usage limits and quality, operational monitoring for outages/security/abuse, and (if consented) promotional notifications.
privacy.s3Body: On withdrawal we immediately deactivate the account, anonymize email/display name, delete region/body/birth/home-gym fields, remove live social login links, and clear session tokens. About 30 days later we hard-purge workouts, favorites, friends, UGC, trades, online PT, tickets, templates, achievements, feature-usage counters, ops activity/access logs linked to the user, owner gym rosters, and uploads. Kept longer without an automatic expiry job (destroyed when the purpose ends or law allows): payment/subscription evidence, consent records, trial-abuse identity keys, and social-provider identifier archives (rejoin/audit/dispute). We do not collect member GPS (any legacy coordinates are defensively cleared). Consent/login IP/UA are scrubbed after about 1 year; login events deleted after about 1 year; banner events after about 90 days; ops aggregates and per-user activity days after about 1 year; ops app logs after about 180 days; ops error events after about 1 year.
privacy.s4Body: To run the service we may process or transfer data via hosting (Render), frontend hosting (GitHub Pages), custom-domain CDN (Cloudflare when used), DB/storage (Supabase), social login (Kakao/Google/Apple), payments (Polar), optional error monitoring (Sentry when configured), email (SMTP or Resend; FormSubmit only if an operator explicitly enables it), and YouTube embeds. Sensitive card data is handled by the payment provider.
privacy.s5Body: In Settings > Privacy Rights Center you can view processing purposes, request access/correction/deletion/processing stop, manage marketing/event/service notification consents, and download your data. Account withdrawal is separate in Settings.
privacy.s6Body: MachineFit accounts (social signup) are not available under age 14. At signup we compute full years from date of birth in Korea time on the server and do not create a user if under 14. A checkbox alone is not sufficient. Gym-owner facility member birth dates are an exception for facility management only and do not create a MachineFit account.
privacy.s7Body: We apply access control, encrypted transport, and role separation. See the security notice page for details. Privacy inquiries: machinefit.official@gmail.com or in-app support. The privacy officer’s name/contact will be listed here after business registration is finalized.
privacy.s8Body: This policy applies from 2026-08-17. Changes will be announced in-app and by updating the revision date on this page. (Previous: 2026-08-15 — aligned ops telemetry, usage counters, storage, withdrawal archives, and no-GPS practice.)

legal.locationLead: How we process region (city/district) data. We do not collect member GPS.

locationDoc.s1Body: We may process city/district data you select for rankings and gym search. We do not collect, store, or send browser GPS / current-location coordinates.
locationDoc.s2Body: Region is optional in Settings. You can skip it and still use name search and other features.
locationDoc.s3Body: Selected region data is deleted on account deletion or when you clear it. We do not keep member GPS coordinates.
locationDoc.s4Body: We do not sell location data. Hosting providers process it only as needed to run the service.
locationDoc.s5Body: Use in-app Support or the Privacy Rights center for location inquiries.

legal.marketingLead: How we send event, promotion, and product updates when you opt in.

marketingDoc.s1Body: Service news, events, promotions, and offers may be sent mainly as in-app notifications. Email is used only when an email channel is configured by operators. Device push (FCM/APNs) is not used currently.
marketingDoc.s2Body: Marketing consent is optional and does not affect signup or core features.
marketingDoc.s3Body: You can withdraw anytime in Settings → Privacy Rights. After withdrawal we stop marketing-style notifications.
marketingDoc.s4Body: Use in-app Support for marketing consent questions.

legal.commerceLead: Payment, free trial, cancellation, refunds, and cooling-off for Premium and other paid features.

commerce.s1Body: Paid memberships such as MachineFit Premium may be charged via Polar or another payment processor. Some Online PT credits may still be demo (not a real card charge). The amount shown at checkout controls.
commerce.s2Body: Subscription and payment status are available under My Page billing. Card numbers are stored by the payment provider, not in our app database.
commerce.s3Body: New accounts may receive an automatic Premium trial (e.g. 7 days) per operating policy. Whether paid renewal starts after the trial follows the notice at signup/checkout. You may cancel during the trial.
commerce.s4Body: Cancel renewals in My Page; future renewals stop after cancellation. Digital/period services are generally non-refundable once delivery has started, except where e-commerce law requires otherwise. Duplicate or erroneous charges: contact Support (billing).
commerce.s5Body: Seller/business details appear in the app footer business notice. Blank fields will be filled after business/mail-order registration. Contact support for payment issues.

legal.communityLead: Rules for posts, comments, photos, and listings.

communityDoc.s1Body: Abuse, hate, NSFW, illegal, infringing, or fraudulent content is prohibited. Filters and moderation may apply.
communityDoc.s2Body: Users may report posts/comments/photos/friends/trades and block friends.
communityDoc.s3Body: Authors may delete; admins may hide content. Legal violations may be actioned without prior notice.
communityDoc.s4Body: By uploading, you grant a non-exclusive license needed to operate and display the service. You keep ownership.
communityDoc.s5Body: Sponsored content will be labeled. Paid ad inventory is limited today.

legal.copyrightLead: Rights for machine/brand images, YouTube, and user uploads.

copyright.s1Body: Catalog images are operator-uploaded references. We do not invent license credits. Unclear rights are taken down on a valid complaint. Logos and product photos belong to their owners.
copyright.s2Body: Embedded videos are subject to YouTube terms; processing is disclosed in the Privacy Policy.
copyright.s3Body: You must have rights to upload. Unauthorized photos may be reported and removed.
copyright.s4Body: Use Support (copyright) or content report reason copyright.
copyright.s5Body: Each brand name, product name, and trademark is a registered trademark or trademark of its respective owner. MachineFit is an independent service and does not imply affiliation, endorsement, or an official relationship with any manufacturer.
copyright.s6Body: The UI uses Inter (SIL Open Font License) and Lucide icons. Manufacturer product photos and wordmark PNGs without a license file are not shown in the catalog; we use original SVGs or a placeholder. Admin-uploaded covers are the operator’s responsibility and are removed on a valid complaint.

legal.aiLead: Reference-only notices for recommendations, insights, and Online PT.

ai.s1Body: Recommendations, insights, and PT answers are not medical diagnosis and do not replace professionals.
ai.s2Body: AI/algorithm outputs are estimates and may be wrong. Check your condition before training.
ai.s3Body: You are responsible for injuries during training to the extent permitted by law.
ai.s4Body: Trainer answers and automated guidance should be understood separately. Seek a professional if unsure.

legal.securityLead: How MachineFit protects personal data and what users should do.

securityDoc.s1Body: APIs are protected with authentication and role checks. Admin and gym-owner features require elevated permissions.
securityDoc.s2Body: The service is served over HTTPS. Access tokens stay in memory only. Refresh tokens are stored as an HttpOnly cookie on the API host when the browser allows it, and also in sessionStorage as a fallback when GitHub Pages → Render blocks third-party cookies. Closing the tab clears sessionStorage. Social credentials are tokens/links, not local passwords.
securityDoc.s3Body: We may review ops logs and optional monitoring tools for abuse. If a breach is confirmed we act and notify as required by law.
securityDoc.s4Body: Lock your device and sign out on shared devices. Contact support if you notice suspicious access.

legal.illegalUseLead: Notice on lawful use of MachineFit and cooperation with authorities when illegal or abusive use is involved.

illegalUseDoc.s1Body: Users must use MachineFit only for lawful purposes under applicable laws and these terms, and must not use the service for illegal acts or to infringe others’ rights.
illegalUseDoc.s2Body: If MachineFit confirms or reasonably suspects illegal or abusive use, it may restrict or suspend the user’s access and, where necessary, retain and review related data.
illegalUseDoc.s3Body: If such conduct appears to violate law or involve crime, MachineFit may report it to the relevant authorities and, within the scope required for investigation, provide materials and other necessary cooperation as permitted by law.
illegalUseDoc.s4Body: Users must comply with applicable laws when using MachineFit. All liability arising from illegal use rests with the user concerned.

peerComparison.interpretAbove: You are growing faster than similar users.

consistency.above: More workout days can help you outgrow similar users.
consistency.near: Workout days are low. Aim for 2–3 logged days per week.
consistency.below: Long gaps slow progress. Restart with a shorter cycle.

intensity.above: Volume is steady but plateauing. Try the next total volume target.
intensity.near: Daily total volume is flat. Add a little weight or sets.
intensity.below: Time to raise intensity. Increase daily total volume gradually.

volume.above: Strong growth. Balance workout days and total volume.
volume.near: Average growth. Try raising daily total volume a bit more.
volume.below: Slower than peers. Increase total volume step by step.

recovery.above: Recent daily volume dropped. Recover, then build back up.
recovery.near: Volume decreased. Resume within a comfortable range.
recovery.below: Your recent training load rose quickly. Consider a lighter week.

maintain.above: Ahead of similar users. Keep your current pace.
maintain.near: Doing well vs average. Avoid big jumps.
maintain.below: Good progress. Focus on the next total volume target.

tips.consistency: Logging on similar weekdays makes daily trends easier to read.
tips.intensity: Track both daily max weight and total volume for balanced progress.
tips.volume: A ~10% daily volume increase is a safe progression.
tips.recovery: Prioritize sleep and protein; focus on volume recovery this week.
tips.maintain: Raise your daily volume target in ~50 kg steps every 2–3 weeks.
tips.plateau: If total volume stalls 2+ weeks, add a machine or an extra set.
tips.lowFrequency: Few workout days in this period. Aim for at least 2 per week.
tips.abovePeer: Growth is above similar users. Watch for overtraining.
tips.belowPeer: To match peers, try increasing daily total volume by 10–15%.

tips.consistency: Logging on the same weekdays makes trends easier to read.
tips.intensity: Train around RPE 7–8 instead of failure every set for sustainable gains.
tips.volume: Adding 2.5 kg per set while keeping set count is a safe progression.
tips.recovery: Prioritize sleep and protein; focus on form over PRs this week.
tips.maintain: Try a 2.5–5 kg increase every 2–3 weeks for progressive overload.
tips.plateau: If weight stalls for 2+ weeks, add one set or shorten rest periods.
tips.lowFrequency: Recent logs are sparse. Target at least twice per week.
tips.abovePeer: You are growing faster than similar users. Watch for overtraining.
tips.belowPeer: To match the cohort average, try raising total volume by 10–15%.
